runs.text: Canada, judged like Israel. Ready? Official report. Finding one: Canada is stolen land. Even the name is borrowed. Kanata, an Iroquoian word for village. Finding two: Quebec voted twice on leaving. In nineteen ninety five, No won by about one percent. Finding three: for forty nine years, Canada and Denmark fought over a tiny island. With whisky. In twenty twenty two, they split it in half. Finding four: Quebec keeps a strategic reserve of maple syrup. Finding five: Canada geese, now all over Europe. Nobody invited them. Settler colonialism. Sounds ridiculous? Israel hears it every day. Canada isn't an apartheid state. Neither is Israel, where one in five citizens is Arab. Both have real problems. One standard. Same test, from the top.
